statement: At every finite place away from3 of K=Q(zeta3), all ramified local sections of the intrinsic metabelian geometric pro-three group of the nine-punctured Fermat cubic are the nine cusp families (Z3 minus zero) times Z3/(q-1). Their actual full-to-metabelian map is a homeomorphism, so each has exactly one full section class above it. Every unramified metabelian section also has a full lift, giving surjectivity of the entire local section map.

notes: The case of zero abelian inertia is proved by three-times-trace cusp transitions and the actual inverse-homology isomorphism, giving zero metabelian inertia.
For nonzero abelian inertia, the surviving cusp module is Z3[[V/Z3 vi]], with Frobenius q times the actual affine map F(g)+[z]-[zi]. Integral invariant measures have exactly one fixed-point support.

The conjugating correction uses the closed equality (di^(3^r)-1)A=(di^a-1)A and an explicit power-series unit. The faithful Magnus comparison proves C_M(di^a)=<di> for every nonzero a, including nonunit exponents.
All exact inverse-limit assertions are proved with compact lift sets or extension of finite characters. No Mittag-Leffler or lim1 vanishing is presumed.
